historical_exposure: 2022H2-2023 outcomes have been viewed in other unrelated strategy families; results are retrospective, not untouched OOS. No threshold changes after evaluation.
hypothesis: An intraday excursion below the prior-close-only 20-session lower Bollinger band, followed by a close back above that band in the upper half of the session range, may identify a volatility-normalized failed breakdown.

candidate_pool.universe: Rows in the frozen Yahoo daily OHLCV panel with complete, internally valid positive-volume bars.
candidate_pool.band: Prior lower band = mean of the immediately preceding 20 official-session closes minus 2 population standard deviations; the signal-day close is excluded from band estimation.
candidate_pool.event: Signal-day low < prior lower band and signal-day close > prior lower band.

score_and_selection.score: Equal-weight mean of signal-day close location and (close - prior lower band)/(high - low).
score_and_selection.selection: Score descending, at most 5 names per XTKS session, up to five eligible candidates; abstain if empty.
score_and_selection.cooldown: One immediately following official XTKS session per selected symbol; only selected rows update cooldown.

target: Signal-date OHLCV setup; enter next official XTKS session open and exit fifth official XTKS session close, with 0.5% primary round-trip cost assumption.

gates_each_discovery_period.minus10_minus20_rates: no higher than the complete candidate pool on the same dates
gates_each_discovery_period.positive_months: at least half of resolved selection months
gates_each_discovery_period.complete_daily_cohorts: at least 20 complete dates; net mean, median, and top3-excluded mean all > 0
gates_each_discovery_period.family_decision: Both 2022H2 and 2023 must pass every gate; otherwise reject without replacement parameters.
